card.title: PS5 EDM-010 USB TPS2001D Power-Distribution Switch Pinout and Function

source.title: PlayStation 5 USB Power Switch TPS2001D Location and Pinout

claims.statement: The TPS2001D is used as a USB power-distribution switch on the PS5 EDM-010 board.
claims.evidence: Image shows the TPS2001D IC located on the EDM-010 motherboard with an arrow pointing to its pinout diagram.

card.caveats: This image provides component pinout and functional descriptions but does not provide specific voltage or resistance measurements for troubleshooting.
